ROOTED IN COMMUNITY • OPEN TO EVERYONE

MORE THAN A TEAM.
A PLACE TO BELONG.

For many South Asian families, basketball is more than a game. It is a chance for young people to build friendships, find mentors, celebrate their heritage and feel proud of who they are. FTC creates a welcoming space where the next generation can grow together—on the court and in life.

CULTURE & BELONGING

Celebrating the diversity of South Asian families while welcoming athletes from every background, faith and experience level.

ROLE MODELS & MENTORS

Connecting young players with coaches and community members who model dedication, discipline, respect and service.

FAMILIES UNITED

Bringing parents, siblings, volunteers and supporters together around a shared goal: helping our youth thrive.

The 2027 Season Starts in February

2026 Season Wrap-Up: Congratulations to our young athletes for an outstanding season and tournament performances. Thank you to the families, coaches and supporters who made it possible. We look forward to seeing everyone back in February 2027!
2027 SEASON INFORMATION

More Than Basketball

Players have the opportunity to learn from experienced coaches who have competed and played at the highest levels of basketball. Whether you’re just starting out or pursuing the next level, we’re here to help you develop your skills, confidence, and understanding of the game.

SKILL DEVELOPMENT

Fundamentals, training and competitive basketball opportunities.

TEAMWORK & LEADERSHIP

Building respect, sportsmanship, discipline and confidence.

COMMUNITY & CULTURE

Creating a welcoming community and meaningful friendships.
